releaseNotes:
v2.28.0 — Purchase restore, better billing errors, font scaling
• Billing: added Restore Purchases button to recover any undelivered purchases
• Billing: ITEM_ALREADY_OWNED now auto-restores the pending purchase
• Billing: specific error messages for each failure code (SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, DEVELOPER_ERROR, etc.)
• Billing: startup auto-restore of any unconsumed/unacknowledged purchases
• Home menu: all font sizes reduced 25-35% to prevent text cutoff on low-res displays
• Tests: 795 passing (added 6 Restore Purchase tests)
